name: litgpt (pretrain)
summary: Truncated reproduction of the litgpt pretrain path: pythia-14m, 8 optimizer steps on WikiText-2 via the TextFiles data module. Certified by an independent cold rebuild on a fresh GPU-less-path host that had never seen the row: exit 0, 4/4 steps, the same 169 MB checkpoint and the same val loss 9.7379, with all 67 recorded pins present at the recorded versions. The training code reproduced exactly - the loss trajectory was bit-identical across four independent environments at seed 42. Every obstacle was in packaging rather than in the model: litgpt download raises AttributeError on huggingface_hub >= 1.0 while litgpt's own pin permits it; torchmetrics and litdata are imported unconditionally on the pretrain path but declared only as optional extras; the pinned litdata==0.2.59 drags an unbounded torchvision that hard-pins an exact torch, silently replacing a curated PyTorch; and wandb/mlflow are advertised logger choices that appear in no dependency group. No litgpt source file was modified.
experimentUrlNote: bridge not armed; recipe did not enable logging
